Triage: `pm:queue`, `domain:devx` (`packages/sdui-parser` per lane table), type Bug. Sibling-ruling reuse: objectui#5661's triage ruled option (b) — collapse the run, keep one boundary space when an inline sibling precedes/follows, parent edges still drop — and it landed downstream. Adopt the same rule verbatim here (the card's own recommendation), including the `<ul>` whitespace-only-run bound pin the downstream PR carries, so the two parsers agree. Reopen only if a real semantic difference between the copies is measured (none found: the diff is objectui's provenance stamp only).
